intent.summary: Presents raster, vector, or symbolic visual content with explicit scaling and semantic purpose.
useWhen: Visual content conveys information, identity, or decoration
avoidWhen: A shape or text pattern more accurately describes the content

semantics.sizing: intrinsic source size transformed by fit policy and parent constraints

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Portable resource identifier or data binding, not an OS-specific filesystem path.

attributes.name: contentMode
attributes.description: How source aspect ratio maps into destination bounds.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Whether the image is informative, functional, or decorative.

attributes.name: accessibleName
attributes.description: Localized equivalent for non-decorative visual meaning.

constraints.message: Non-decorative images require an accessible name.

accessibility.nameSource: accessibleName for informative images; owning control for functional images
accessibility.focusBehavior: not focusable unless composed into an interactive control
notes: Decorative images are excluded from the accessibility tree.

mappings.strategy: Capture resource identity, resizability, aspect policy, and accessibility purpose.
caveats: Remote loading is behavior outside layout metadata.

mappings.strategy: Select raster, vector, or symbolic representation from resource metadata.
